requiredFindings.title: Missing, inaccessible, and unsupported H share one custody row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: H exists, the open succeeds, and is_home_filesystem refuses the sample. Item 5 ends on CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED with a walk sub-detail. The write gate returns GateRefusal::Filesystem and 468 item 6 ends on NT-TCB-BOOT subject INSTALL_ROOT_FS. The same sentence sends an EACCES open to that custody row; missing() does not treat EACCES as a missing open, and the write gate publishes HOST.IO_FAILURE exit 4.

requiredFindings.title: A fence carrier that is no longer a regular file takes the custody row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: During the wait, metadata on the retained fence descriptor reports that it is no longer a regular file. try_acquire returns Err. Item 11 ends on the custody row, request-rejected exit 2. lock_fence maps that Err to IoFailure::Lock, and 468c publishes HOST.IO_FAILURE, host-io, exit 4.

priorFindings.r2: The actor-row cell and the busy-row collapse are closed. The home sentence still groups three write-gate rows onto custody, and a non-regular fence carrier during the wait is custody rather than host I/O.

scope: Law 458c r3: the r2 missing-home row and the fence-wait I/O row.
